steps.name: подготовка
steps.js: window.__tap = (x, y) => { const o = { clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true, pointerId: 1 }; document.getElementById('game').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', o)); }; document.querySelector('.title .btn').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); FB.ui.closeAll(); const S = FB.S; S.tut = 99; S.tips = { bubbles: 1 }; S.stats.catches = 40; S.xp = 1500; S.level = FB.state.levelFromXp(1500); S.season.pts = 1040; S.daily.streak = 9; FB.hud.update(); return S.level;

steps.name: колёсико
steps.js: const st = document.querySelector('.tiers'); const before = st.scrollLeft; st.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: 300, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); return [before, st.scrollLeft];

steps.name: турнир: я в месте недели
steps.js: FB.ui.closeAll(); const cfg = FB.state.weekCfg(); FB.panels.goTo('arena'); FB.ui.closeAll(); const f = FB.fishOfPond(cfg.pond); FB.state.applyCatch({ kind: 'fish', fish: f[3], g: f[3].w[1] }, { pond: 'arena' }, true); FB.state.applyCatch({ kind: 'fish', fish: f[0], g: f[0].w[0] }, { pond: 'arena' }, true); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.hud.update(); return FB.S.week;

steps.name: дальний заброс
steps.js: FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.panels.goTo('village'); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.S.rod = 'bamboo'; FB.scene.setPlace('village', 'sun'); const p = FB.scene.project(0.6, 0.9); __tap(p.x, p.y); return FB.fishing.phase;
